question: How many customers do we have?
Which city has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers are there in each city?
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city

question: How many orders are in each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: What is the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average unit price per product category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')

question: What is the revenue by product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY p.category

question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which city generates the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT c.city FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of each product category were sold, including all order statuses?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: Which customer placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)
